reason: Successfully navigated to the agent, sent a message asking "What is 2+2?", received a response containing "4" within 3 seconds.
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Page loaded successfully showing the sidebar with agent list.
Clicked on agent "QA-20261021-191623-bwd5" in the sidebar — Page navigated to the agent home page showing status "idle" and empty chat interface.
Verified agent status is "idle" — Status indicator displayed "idle" in the UI header, meeting the requirement of "running or idle".
Typed message "Hello! What is 2+2?" in the message input textbox — Text successfully entered in the input field.
Clicked Send message button — Message was sent, page navigated to the chat session, and agent status changed to "working" showing activity indicator.
Waited for agent response — Agent responded within ~3 seconds with the message "2 + 2 = 4."

Verified response mentions "4" and took screenshot — The agent's response clearly shows "2 + 2 = 4." and screenshot (qa_test_response.png) was captured showing the complete conversation with the correct answer.
